description: FreshRSS: a self-hosted RSS and Atom aggregator with multi-user accounts and the Google Reader and Fever APIs. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

NATS JetStream Controller (NACK): manage JetStream streams, consumers, key-value and object stores and accounts on a NATS server from Kubernetes custom resources. The six CRDs ship with the chart. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
